description:
Global header/footer/custom sections shown on every page. Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- list_global_sections: List reusable global sections (Header, Footer, shared content blocks) — SLIM summary only.
- get_global_section: Get one global section as a COMPACT tree (3-5x fewer tokens than raw JSON).
- create_global_section: Create a reusable global section (Header / Footer / shared block) the way the builder does: persists a global_section record AND embeds the same section node into page sources s…
- delete_global_section: Delete a global section (Header/Footer/block) and remove its node from every page source.
- search_global_section_elements: Search/filter elements within a global section (Header/Footer/block) without dumping the whole tree.
- get_global_section_element: Get full detail (style, config, specials, events, bindings, responsive bp1..bp4, children IDs) of a single element inside a global section.

dry_run.description: Preview which pages would change (true) or perform the atomic save (false). [create_global_section, delete_global_section]

global_section_id.description: Global section ID (from list_global_sections) [get_global_section, search_global_section_elements, get_global_section_element]

has_custom_class.description: Only elements with a custom class [search_global_section_elements]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

raw.description: Return the FULL raw section JSON (large) instead of the compact tree — delivered via the large-re… [get_global_section]

section.description: A section node from new_section (object or JSON string) — the content of the header/footer. [create_global_section]

section_id.description: The global section's section_id (the section node id) — from list_global_sections. [delete_global_section]

type.description: header = top chrome (logo/nav/cart), footer = bottom chrome, section = reusable content block [create_global_section, search_global_section_elements]

name: global_section
